summary: Contribution by Kristian Muri Knausgård. The proof uses the reflected one-prime moment of knausgard-rh-reflected-bhb-78 (85.39%) and the optimised kernel of knausgard-rh-reflected-kernel-8542 (85.4225%). Let U be the short prime sum and F = ζ′(ρ)B(ρ)/log T the mollified derivative. The new input is the mean of Re(F conj(U²)). The D9 modules prove the two-prime case of Yuanda Xu’s Theorem 5.1 (arXiv:2611.34546) for these weights. A rational sum-of-squares inequality at each zero, averaged using fifteen moment bounds, gives N_d ≥ (0.85536627778 − o(1))N under RH on (T, 2T] and (0, T]. The formal proof of the Bui–Heath-Brown mollified moments comes from knausgard-rh-bui-heath-brown-deg40.
method: Reflected mixed-moment certificate with the optimised explicit-formula kernel, a two-prime mixed moment and a rational sum-of-squares bound for multiplicities.
